patches.name: Unlock Premium (Root)
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features by injecting an active RevenueCat entitlement into the customer info. Requires root: this app is protected by Firebase App Check with Play Integrity, so the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install (e.g. morphe-cli patch --mount) — a re-signed sideload will fail server-side attestation.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks all Pro and PowerPack premium features by forcing the entitlement gates to return true. Requires root: this app is shielded by Google Play PairIP, so the patched build must be mounted over the genuine Play-signed install (e.g. morphe-cli patch --mount) — a normal sideload will not run.
